verdict: Lossless at every batch size: True.
Batched verification saved verify passes in 0/0 multi-sequence configurations (a batch of one has nothing to batch).

Peak sequences verified per target pass: 1.0. A per-sequence verifier would have needed that many passes per round, so this is the factor by which speculation and batching compose rather than conflict.

Values below 1.0 are not a defect of the composition. The draft runs K passes serially per sequence per round, and this model pair (HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct against HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct) is too close in cost for that to pay.
The plan's 2-3x claim is a GPU claim about a pair with a real cost gap, so it is neither confirmed nor refuted here. Re-run with --device cuda to measure it on a GPU.
